candidates.similarity: Both command exclusive worship of God and reject worship of other deities.
candidates.difference: Deuteronomy addresses Israel in covenantal law and includes reverence and oaths; Qur'an 10:104 is Muhammad's first-person declaration addressed to humanity, with God as the one who causes death.
candidates.limits: General shared monotheistic injunction, not a distinctive textual match; no critical apparatus, manuscript comparison or transmission route established.
